name: Promotions
description: Automatic, no-code discounts — catalog-zone (a product's own price drops when it matches a rule) and cart-zone (an order-level discount or free shipping). A promotion is a container of ordered tiers, each its own condition scope and discount, so one sale event can have several discount depths without needing a promotion per depth. Coupon codes stay torgash.checkout's own separate, simpler feature.

settings.label: Countdown on product cards
settings.help: A small timer among the labels on the card's photo, for a product in a running sale that has "Show a countdown" ticked and an end. On the product page the full countdown under the price is always there.

settings.label: A bar in the basket
settings.help: Under the basket's total: from what sum delivery is free, a bar of how much the basket already holds, and what is missing — or that it is won. Drawn only while a running promotion with "Free shipping" and "Cart subtotal is at least" could give it to this basket.

options.after_buy_box: Under the buy panel, as a card of its own

settings.label: On the product page
settings.help: The same note beside the product, kept up to date as things go into the basket.
